title: Understanding the Bootstrap Distribution
text: The bootstrap distribution shows the variability of the difference in means, \( \hat{\delta} $$=$$ \bar{K} - \bar{D} \). It is used to estimate the sampling distribution of the statistic.

title: Interpreting the Percentiles
text: The $$2.5th$$ and $$97.5th$$ percentiles mark the boundaries of the middle 95% of the bootstrap distribution. If \( \hat{\delta}_{obs} \) lies within these boundaries, it suggests that the observed difference is not statistically significant at the $$0.05$$ level.

title: Position of \( \hat{\delta}_{obs} \)
text: Check where the observed difference \( \hat{\delta}_{obs} \) lies in relation to the $$2.5th$$ and $$97.5th$$ percentiles. If it is within these percentiles, we fail to reject the null hypothesis.

title: Conclusion Based on the Plot
text: Does \( \hat{\delta}_{obs} \) lie within the $$2.5th$$ and $$97.5th$$ percentiles of the bootstrap distribution?
